test_coverage_notes: Testing for this code would typically be found in unit/integration tests for NFT modification transactions, likely in files such as 'test/tx/NFTokenModify_test.cpp', 'test/tx/NFToken_test.cpp', or similar. Tests should cover: (1) owner/account mismatch, (2) URI length/emptiness, (3) non-existent NFT, (4) immutable NFT, (5) issuer/minter permissions, (6) successful modification. Gaps may exist if tests do not cover all combinations of optional fields (e.g., missing sfOwner, missing sfURI), or edge cases like issuer account missing in ledger. Coverage for error codes (temMALFORMED, tecNO_ENTRY, tecNO_PERMISSION, tecINTERNAL) should be verified.

Checks if sfURI is not empty

Checks if the NFT with sfNFTokenID exists for the owner
Checks if the NFT is mutable (flagMutable set)
Checks if the transaction sender is the issuer or minter of the NFT
If not, checks if the issuer's account exists
If not, checks if the minter matches the sender
